datasetGate.rights: Documented commercial use, ML training, evaluation, redistribution/processing as needed, and underlying participant-text rights.
datasetGate.provenance: Original source, collection method, human annotation method, guideline, and source-group identifier are documented.
datasetGate.construct: English first-person Event text with exhaustive or explicit pairwise Product-18 applicability judgments.

experimentAuthorizationGate: Dataset gate passes before any candidate training.
Acquisition row ranking is frozen before imported human labels are opened.
A single confusion-aware objective and training configuration is frozen before development evaluation.
RTN remains unopened until the final candidate is frozen and is evaluated at most once.
failureAction: If explicit negative judgments or legal provenance are missing, do not train; keep the manifest as BLOCKED_DATA_ACQUISITION.
